text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a long, hard road getting here,
but it's
finally time for the URA Finale to
begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The battle to see who will rise to the top
on this
shining stage... is about to kick
off!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Stupendous! I see you've just finished
seeing your
trainee off!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I might have set the stage, but you'll be
the stars!
Please, make this race a hit!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! May your Umamusume's
talents shine
brightly on the track!
choice_data_list: 最高のレースにしてみせます！
choice_data_list_en: I'll make this the greatest race ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, the preliminaries for the URA
Finale
begin!
